_about: Graphic themes. Your own brand / client themes go in themes.local.json (gitignored, same format) and can reuse a look with "css": e.g. {"acme": {"css": "bold", "description": "...", "colors": {...}, "captions": {...}}}. A theme restyles every template (themes/<name>.css: type, shapes, decorations, motion feel) and sets the default palette and caption look. Pick one in brand.json "style" (or per video: plan.json "style"). brand.json "colors" / "captions" entries override the theme's values. Caption fonts are full font names from motion/fonts/ttf.

glass.description: Dark translucent cards, accent glow, rounded corners, smooth motion. Tech tutorials.

clean.description: Light and minimal: white cards, soft shadows, calm motion. Corporate, SaaS, explainers.

bold.description: Black and white, heavy condensed capitals, square blocks with hard offset shadows, snappy cuts. Punchy product, sports and tech channels.

neon.description: Black with glowing magenta/cyan outlines, mono labels, springy motion. Tech, gaming, dev tools.

editorial.description: Cream paper, serif headlines, thin rules, slow elegant motion. Stories, documentary, premium.
